notes.title: DEVBLOG #6 - BRAKU
notes.content:
[b]BRAKU[/b] is the harvester golem of the [b]INSINYUR[/b], a work of robotic craftsmanship over 1000 years old and counting. [b]Specially designed for The Harvest ritual and unique in its creation[/b].

This robust and lethal relic of war is the mechanical representation of the INSINYUR, a species for which hand-to-hand combat is totally out of its possibilities.
Among their creations, [b]BRAKU is the longest-lived and with the fewest systemic failures recorded[/b]. This surprising condition is suspected to be due to BRAKU's continued exposure to the essence of O'Ree-Jin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/a7c1cbb61b813487add6fd0381c743ad87cdc39c.png[/img]

Among the members of the Commonwealth Drifters (Duke), frequent allies of the INSINYUR, there is a belief that [b]BRAKU has reached a superior state of a simple mechanical golem[/b], and also that a cybernetic symbiosis between essence and machine has been produced inside it, creating a unique new way of life in O'Ree-Jin.

In addition to its large storage capacity, which makes it a living essence bounty when it’s full, BRAKU has an armor made of Tahan, unique material from INSINYUR's planet super resistant to damage. Although he started out as an efficient peaceful harvester, his longevity has led him to undergo changes, updates, and improvements by its creators, adapting to the increasing aggressiveness among Breachers during The Harvest ritual.

Its current version features an electromagnetic shield system, powerful mobility, and a devastating subatomic particle heavy machine gun. Which makes him a fearsome rival to avoid and a precious ally to cling to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/79c8c5910dd89cbbc48de2f27542c57b2bbdd829.png[/img]

[b]The INSINYUR is one of the most technologically advanced civilizations in the galaxy[/b]. Its engineers, with deep knowledge of robotics accumulated over centuries, consider themselves authentic techno-artisans of this discipline, developing a culture around these creations, beyond their simple usefulness, and becoming a key to their world understanding.

All their golems are unique pieces of engineering, creativity, and functionality, they are never mass-produced, it is the techno-craftsmen's way of giving identity and meaning to their creations.

This way of understanding and building their society is a consequence of their fragile and small body, which has forced them to fully develop their already incredible cognitive abilities.

[b]The INSINYUR are capable of concentrating the knowledge of all their ancestors, accessing it and assimilating it instantly through their PERPUSTAKAAN[/b], which allows them to exponentially enhance their research and innovations.

notes.title: DEVBLOG #5 - THE FIRST HARVEST
notes.content:
The Ancients had been living peacefully on the planet [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1223360/view/2216278688523127569]O’Ree-Jin for millennia[/url]. Despite all, stagnation brought a new way of thinking about the Ancients’ development as a species: the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1223360/view/2261317222896510243]Path of wonder[/url]. The followers of the path of wonders exploited O’Ree-Jin’s essence without care for its consequence, and the Ancients tried as peacefully as possible to control that imprudent behavior.

The situation deteriorated as the more the traditional Ancients tried to halt the rampant misuse of the primal substance, the more challenging and transgressive the younger generations became. At some point, the conflict started being more about a fight for power and self-determinism than a philosophical debate about how to tackle knowledge acquisition and science. As tends to happen with those types of conflicts, violence followed.[b] Aggression was something new to Ancient society.[/b] In that sense, most of the aggressive acts were akin to those of a child against a father, those that arise from the frustration of believing oneself in possession of truth and, at the same time, being incapable of imposing that truth. The followers of the path of wonder started disobeying publicly, rioting and destroying property.

This public disobedience was met with a non-aggressive response by the dominant Ancients, and that, in the end, allowed the escalation of aggressive behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/c1e8639e39b917fe28fb2313e084a581f878f1b0.png[/img]

Year after year, decade after decade, positions got more and more radicalized. An extremist group started the acquisition of the substance through live tissue extraction. That meant snatching Ancients and extracting the essence directly from them. [b]This aberrant behavior had its rewards[/b], as it was demonstrated as the most efficient way of substance acquisition (1000 to 1, compared to normal unearthing and atmospherical capture). That method had a precondition, the more accumulated substance the tissue had, the more it could be extracted. This discovery ended up being the demise of the Ancient people. The practice became quite standard among the clandestine experimenters and the more extreme groups among the followers of the Path of wonder.

The practice was a capital fault in the eyes of the sages. The tradition stated that one must choose when to end its current physical form, and the process should entail [b]returning the “life energy” (the essence) to the planetary ecosystem.[/b] That was the pre-condition of all mingling with the substance: in the end, it should always return to the typical flux of the ecosystem. The sages believed that by containing the essence of Ancients and processing it, they were effectively killing them forever. That was the tipping point for the sages that announced harsher measures and the creation of a prosecuting militia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/b87466c39600a1fa9b991093b8eff88eb36e97a2.png[/img]

It all ended quickly after that announcement. It is not clear what happened, as the Ancient life as it has been described ended abruptly. Despite all, some pieces of information and recordings have been recovered from the debacle. Not long after the sages announcement of the recent measures, a terrorist attack took place during an assembly. The attack killed most of the sage caste to end their rulership and, it seems, gathering their accumulated essence. Imagine close to two thousand sages that had on their bodies 50% of the accumulated substance on Ancient society during millennia. Now imagine all that power, all that energy and all that knowledge destroyed in an instant. That act, the consumption of all those bodies for the gain of a few, is nowadays called [b]The First Harvest.[/b]
 
That seems to have created a chain reaction on the planetary ecosystem. Some people believe that, as the sages said, they were connected to the planet, and[b] the trauma was so immense that O’Ree-Jin’s reacted against it[/b], scarred for eons to come. Other people believe that the sudden expulsion of all that energy in a contained space, and when entered in contact with the atmosphere, created the first of the energy storms that we see on the present day, and it created a feedback loop that made the whole planet “explode” on energy.

notes.title: DEVBLOG #4 - THE PATH OF WONDER
notes.content:
At some point in their history (not much before their extinction), a schism in their form of life happened. It seems there had always been divergent ways of thinking around the scriptures and the role of the Ancients as the dominant species of [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b]. Most of the time, those dissonant voices didn’t get enough traction to create a significant debate among the Ancients. At some point, one of these voices gained enough following to challenge the dominant way of thinking. They summarized these beliefs with an apostate pamphlet named The Path of Wonder that contradicted basic precepts of the Ancients culture:
 
[list]
[*] One realizes his potential by means of consumption.
[*] One is able to consume because he is able to produce.
[*] One produces as much as he needs.
[*] One’s needs must be contained by his ability to grow.
[*] One shall grow through diligence.
[*] Diligence is learned by providing to the community.
[*] The community's ultimate goal should be to realize its potential.
[/list]
 
Everything we do must rely on this spiral as the power of our people depends on the growth of said people.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/42d42a058d53d2b3955296d5455c36c22191444f.png[/img]
 
This radical change of view proposed a more proactive way of thinking about systemic growth on [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b]. It is mostly attributed to the feeling of some of the Ancients that they were wasting precious time and resources just by not acting on them.
 
The schism tends to be attributed to a natural flaw in the way the Ancients devised growth. The Ancients were capable of amazing biotechnological feats, the like of which has not been seen in other places of the galaxy. At the same time, [b]these technological applications of the essence were always focused on expanding community boundaries[/b], not as raw growth, but as how they related between themselves and the planet. As more applications for the substance were found, more impatient and wondrous the Ancients turned.
 
The followers of the [b]Path of Wonder[/b] advocated for a conjoint effort, policing and regularizing the means of production and the populace's work effort. This could not abide by the majority of the Ancients as it would hinder people's autonomy and freedom. From an outsider’s point of view, it seems the Ancients found their own kind of decadence. Decadence in the Ancients society came through a visceral fear based on the idea of inaction waste:[b] 'if we do not take advantage of the current opportunities, we will face later consequences.'[/b] Some portion of the populace started making exaggerated exploitation and use of the essence for growth, experimentation, and knowledge acquisition. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/2f8d2cc5e9bf8d0273701a901bf171601086f429.png[/img]
 
 
This was achieved mainly through the use of Harvesters. A sophisticated technology that extracted the essence from [b]O’Ree-Jin’s bedrock[/b], fracturing it in the process. This began to impact the environment creating residuals and subproducts of the substance treatment that were quite dangerous to the ecosystem. Moreover, these phenomena created other problems akin to the ones inherent to globalization and worker exploitation. These phenomena were entirely novel in Ancients society.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/ea1ad42d4cd1dc5aa02198f279350934a8a845cc.png[/img]
 
At some point, the sages tried to bring the debate to the public, expand the assembly, incorporate new participants, and [b]reach a mutual consensus between these two ways of thinking[/b]. The popularity of the sages helped sway public opinion their way. Most of the activity of the Path of wonder became clandestine as it became somewhat shameful.
 
The crisis was averted for the moment...

notes.title: DEVBLOG #3 - The Ancients
notes.content:
Little is known about the civilization that dwelled on O’Ree-Jin (from now on Ancients). Despite all, two things are sure: they were a very advanced civilization in terms of technology and ethics; at the same time, they lacked any kind of space-faring technology and, as so, they lived confined to O’Ree-Jin. These two things can be explained if we take a look at what has been recovered from their archives.
 
O’Ree-Jin is itself small, but even so, the Ancients inhabited a little portion of one of the major continents. The Ancients constrained their expansion by choice, as they had a seemingly unending life, and they kept tight control over procreation.
 
That is strange if we account for the vast amount of uninhabited space and unexploited resources around them. That includes the protean substance known as ‘the essence’ that everyone craves now. This way of life is explained by their culture and moral beliefs. All these scriptures relied on a basic circular logic:
 
i) One affects the environment through consumption.
ii) One can consume because he/she can produce.
iii) One produces as much as he needs.
iv) One’s needs must be contained by his/her patience.
v) One must nurture patience through diligence.
vi) Diligence is learned by providing to the community.
vii) The community is the ultimate protector of the environment.
 
Everything we do must rely on this circle as the power of O’Ree-Jin works in circles.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/540575dac0b5ef418fedc23b41d9b34266740ec8.jpg[/img]
 
Around these beliefs emerged basic precepts of how life was organized:
They put extreme effort into educating on a systemic understanding of life and nature. All things are related to each other and affect each other. Self-reliance and independence were a significant quality, but society and the community must allow for it.

They understood life as an extension of unity (dependability among self-organizing organisms).
As those ideas hold true, one should strive to live its life unattached to need and desire, as excesses may corrupt unity and destroy the systemic balance.
The final conclusion is that one must strive to achieve his/her own desires, but that should never come at the cost of the desires of others or the community as a whole.
 
The Ancients hold these beliefs as a moral imperative. That is why they grew so slowly until total stagnation at some point in their history. Although the Ancients were quite an advanced and free society, not having a communal goal more sophisticated than the respect for each other and the ecosystem hindered their apparent advancement and growth. In truth, they were primarily focused on self-knowledge and acquiring a deeper understanding of their community and their place in nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/c9379225cbec699e898001a5333d98cf9f891374.jpg[/img]

To order the cultural and societal affairs of the population, a caste of Sages functioned as an oligarchy. The Sages were mostly members of the earlier generations that formed the Ancient species. Some of them had thousands of years of life and experience. The caste of Sages that functioned as an assembly.
 
The caste was very static, and only when a seat was vacated was another sage able to occupy it. A seat got vacated when a Sage got tired of his/her current life form. When a sage wanted to “return to the planet,” he/she started a slow process of essence extraction from the body, that got re-insufflated into earth pockets rich with the substance. The Sages, as the most longevous people on that planet, were vast containers of the essence that structured life on O’Ree-Jin.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/9a63df12b20b7782e341643e47846413ec893b71.jpg[/img]
 
Most of the time, the Sages didn’t get involved in the decision-making process of most mundane things. In truth, it seems that most of the day to day life was ordained just by custom and the following of the scriptures. Despite all, the sages were admired as those with a better understanding of the scriptures. The Sages understood as no other intimate relationship between the planet as a system, and the essence as the lifeblood of that planet and all the interconnected organisms in it. In that regard, the Sages directed the expansion and evolution of their civilization.
 
That changed during the last centuries of the life of the Ancient species...

notes.title: DEVBLOG #2 - The Imperial Triarchy ORIGIN
notes.content:
[b]Alith[/b] comes from a ruthless, authoritarian and fundamentalist empire. Their people were for centuries the prey of a stronger species that dominated the surface of their planet, while they hid and dwelled in caves connected through an underground galleries system. The giant creatures that inhabited the surface were worshipped, feared, and hated as punishing gods by the underground people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/7ee35d809c7a9c4a18216fc6eaefc32bfa68fbe6.png[/img]

This constant dread for their lives was used by a group of individuals that, while trying to give meaning and logic to these harsh living conditions, also found a way to start accumulating power over the community by establishing strict rules of conduct and a strong religious hierarchy.
 
The dogmatic following of these rules created a new way of life known as the [b]Faith[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/a5e9f544e6a7d703191926a6ed0bbc94f6f799db.png[/img]

Their technology started focusing on learning how these ‘Gods’ bodies worked, and to replicate their capabilities to achieve perfection. They experimented with highly complex biomechanical implants to improve the bodies of their brave explorers, who were sent to the surface looking for resources and knowledge about these giant creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/765a433b646fe30997cfa94e9fccadaa8f1e919b.png[/img]

After many centuries, their technology eventually got good enough to finally face in battle their Gods. This started a war that lasted for decades and ended with the conquest of the surface. This created a massive shift in the prey mentality of the underground people. They had become the predators now, and nobody was going to subject them anymore. That also changed their way of government and religion. That is known as the first foundation, and the religion converted to a new system with two main branches: [b]Faith and War[/b]. 

[list]
[*] [b]The Faith[/b] branch was the ancient way, and it was concerned with the day to day ethics and morals of the peoples. 
[*] [b]The War[/b] branch of the church was born as the war against the Gods neared its end, and it concerned itself with militaristic development, social discipline, and sciences.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/96c3e5b7023dbf1d69ab06382ee540c9c53485ed.png[/img]

Guided by a strong inferiority complex due to their past as a prey species, the next centuries were focused on ‘preventive conquering’. They underwent the creation of a space fleet and started the systematic subjugation of less developed civilizations to consolidate their new mentality. They became 'Gods' among the stars.
 
With expansion came colonization and impregnation from other cultures and societies. In the long run, this created religious tension among the church as progressive individuals started to appreciate the diversity inherent to other species and forms of religion. These produced aberrant behaviors among pockets of populations that encompassed cross-species sexual intercourse, faith conversion, and full-fledged heretical movements.
 
After a civil war engulfed part of the empire, and to avoid heresy, criticism, and opposition inside their society, the Imperium became more authoritarian and less tolerant. As the Imperium conquered its self-doubt, the second foundation took place with the creation of the branch of [b]Truth[/b]. That branch was concerned with dogma and belief. This foundation establishes the current state of political and religious affairs for the Imperium. The Imperium is managed by the church branches known as [b]Faith, War, and Truth, as a Triarchy of power.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/3c17635b6bed33ca69c75ba123fbabcc1e381f58.png[/img]

The branch of [b]Truth[/b] destroyed all recorded history and banned the possibility of keeping records of any past fact. The only holders of the truth were the Triarch of Truth and the [b]Truthsayers[/b]. A Truthsayer was the one that established fact (or rewritten fact), and as so, the Truthsayers ended up functioning as a policing force among the administration of the [b]Imperial Triarchy[/b]. This allowed them to justify any new conquest and aggression, by claiming a ‘holy right’ and a ‘divine quest’ for the ‘universal truth’. Despite all, nowadays, the primary function of a Truthsayers is that of preventing, investigating, and purging heresy wherever it may spawn. To achieve that purpose, the Truthsayers would surgically remove leaders, sabotage whole planets, and target individuals deemed dangerous. Those are known as truth-seeking protocols.
 
In this sad, obscure, and blind period was when [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b] was first discovered by this civilization. The Imperium was the first to find the ruins and the power of the [b]essence[/b]. Taking advantage of that, they rewrote their history again, claiming that the planet was their true origin and their lost paradise, so they had the right to inherit and exploit it. When the triarchy achieves full dominance over the planet, the final foundation will take place.

As other civilizations reached the planet and became engaged in the process of extraction, the truth propagated by the Truthsayers began to crumble. As the conflict was not an option (due to mutually assured destruction), the branch of Truth quarantined all information on [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b]. The only available personnel on orbit around the planet are personnel from the Truth branch of the church. They are deemed the only ones strong enough to mingle with other civilizations' falsehoods and with the events that take place on the planet’s surface.
 
As so, the Truthsayers dispatched to [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b] are specialized in [b]The Harvest[/b] ceremony. They are allowed to work with other civilizations... at least for the moment, as they gather enough truth about them.

notes.title: DEVBLOG #1 - THE ORIGIN OF THE HARVEST
notes.content:
In a remote corner of the Universe, in a time beyond history, there is a place unlike any other. 
This place is known for many as [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b].
[list]
[*] [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b] contains the remains of one of the most advanced civilizations that have inhabited the Universe, and probably the first one to do it.
[*] This ancient planet is inaccessible for most of its existence due to immensely powerful currents of energy that coalesce on the outer layers of the atmosphere, creating the most astounding vista in the galaxy.
[*] Its orbit is a melting pot of vessels, radars, satellites and space stations from different eras, brought there by the greatest galactic civilizations across the Universe, waiting patiently for the planet’s atmosphere to open (not unlike a sort of cold war).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/a7a68a0387021ed6055d64d7e13a63a1ed2115f2.jpg[/img]

[b]O’Ree-Jin[/b] is peculiar for all those reasons but, most of all, it has become a mythical peregrination place because its cortex exudes the most precious substance of the cosmos. Some call this protean substance the blood of God, others call it the essence of life, and some even say that it is the very fabric of reality in its primal form. No matter how they call it, every one of the orbiting civilizations wants to amass it, process it, and build whatever their imagination dims possible. This substance grants elongated life, benign, and powerful mutations. It may replicate any form, be it organic or synthetic. All in all, it is the clay from what everything else is built.

As tends to happen with all important things in existence, the acquisition of this substance comes associated with a most dangerous path. The planet is a zealous protector of this substance, but it may reward those foolish enough to try to brave it. The planet opens itself at undetermined intervals and for an undetermined time span. These little windows of time become hectic with activity as bands of warriors and adventurers lunge themselves to the planet’s surface and battle to the death to attain as much of the substance as possible. These warriors are among the most exalted heroes of each civilization. They build short-lived alliances between them and become agents of death and chaos as they attain the substance for themselves, becoming more powerful than they ever expected to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36794131/a1c67f6d67783014c6bf4b375fb4bb2cd97ddf7d.png[/img]

The substance extraction is peculiar as the best way to conserve it is through living tissue. The warriors, or [b]Breachers[/b] as they call themselves, become a living canister full of the all empowering substance. Along [b]O’Ree-Jin[/b]’s surface, [b]Breachers[/b] find vestiges of essence extraction machinery (EEM) still functioning, becoming this the main focus of their harvesting. 
But a faster, more brutal, and nastier way of substance gathering is harvesting the bodies of opposing [b]Breachers[/b]. That has been happening for centuries, and that will be the way for centuries to come. This ritualistic activity has been named as [b]The Harvest[/b].

notes.title: Welcome to The Harvest Steam Page
notes.content:
[u][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/u]
“The Harvest is a different proposal in the Hero-shooter and Battle Royale genres. We want our players to participate in the development process and give us insights about the game experience.
The Harvest is going to be an involved experience with multiple systems that empower the player experience and innovate upon the Battle Royale formula. We have clear expectations about the gameplay we want to achieve, but that objective is only reachable with the help of an active community.
We have a solid grounding and a fun experience for the first stage of the Early Access process, and that is why we want to involve the community now, as early as possible. We need to build new and exciting systems to come with the help of our players, taking into account their feedback and insights.”

[b][u]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/u][/b]
“Bringing The Harvest to its full potential will take us at least a year. We cannot state a specific date, but we are aiming for a 2021 full release.”

[u][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/u]
“The Harvest's development cycle is reaching a very dynamic and malleable phase. We have a clearly defined roadmap, but we want to involve the community to ascertain that each and every new feature improves and builds upon the game's experience.
During the Early Access, we're going to add new content such as new breachers, more abilities, ultimate abilities, weapons, map improvements, and new gameplay systems.”

[b][u]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/u][/b]
“The first Early Access stage offers to the players an exciting experience with:
4 Unique Characters (Breachers)
2 Active Abilities per Breacher
1 Weapon per Breacher
Squads of 3 Breachers
30 players per match
Harvesting System
Looting System
Progression system during the round (Attributes and Abilities)”

[u][b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/u]
“We are immensely grateful to the players that believe in The Harvest and support its development from the beginning. To reward these players, the game will have a lower price on the first stages of Early Access. We plan to increase the price gradually as we add new content and features.”

[u][b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b][/u]
“Our community has been involved in our development cycle from the very beginning: from different tournaments and expos to social networks, and of course, our Discord server. Our players have been participating in the development of the game with feedback, playtesting, fan-art, etc. We will double our efforts to involve more people and get as much feedback as possible in the future.”
